retrieved_synopses: The player notices a loose stone in the Duergar Camp.There is a hidden stash underneath.
The player tries to read a bronze plaque in a tomb.
In a well-lit cave. Player looks at a fresco depicting a group of druids standing over a vanquished army. Pass a test to realise that the army was the army of Shar - a Dark Goddess.
Following a passive arcana check, the player comments that a chest discovered at a shrine has a spell cast over it, protecting its contents.
Shadowheart comments on her suspicions that there is probably to the crypt than just a mausoleum. Hinting at the existence of the temple.
context: The party has come upon a tomb that holds an artefact of Selune and are examining the chamber and its fittings. Earlier observations and checks have suggested the presence of sealed or warded containers and hidden compartments, so traps and concealment are a real possibility. A bronze plaque and a fresco nearby hint at a deeper temple history—one scene even implies a victory over forces of Shar—and Shadowheart has already voiced suspicion that this is more than a simple mausoleum. The player’s line about the effort to hide a sarcophagus expresses reverent fear and the sense that whoever protected this place went to great lengths to conceal the artefact.
